name: Banjoume Banjou
source:
Saint Mirowa Academy second-year student, Alto's love rival, the rich kid. An extreme narcissist who wears a compact mirror around his neck for self-admiration.

"Oh! My swee~ety honey Kurumi-chaaaan! Walking together on the way to school, we're both popular at Saint Mirowa Academy, Let's walk anytime, everywhere~♪"

He's fiercely pursuing Kurumi. To the point of stalking her.Despite that, Manjo-kun is so popular he has his own group of admirers at the academy. He also happens to be the partner who enhances Kuru's magical power (in a sexual way).

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080415135230/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/majokko/chara/ch_04.html]archived official site[/url]]
